all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The President announced a series of measures in February to reduce the outflow of U.S. private capital, including the extension of the Interest Equalisation Tax (IET) to bank loans to borrowers in developed countries.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: By limiting capital outflow, the measures aim to stabilize the economy and encourage domestic investment, which can enhance growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The measures were announced and put into effect to address the capital outflow issue.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reform addresses a significant economic issue by attempting to stabilize capital flows, which is crucial for maintaining economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: The President announced a series of measures in February to reduce the outflow of U.S. private capital, including the extension of the Interest Equalisation Tax (IET).
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description focuses on reducing the outflow of private capital and mentions the Interest Equalisation Tax, which does not directly relate to public R&D funding or innovation instruments for firms.
